finding.expected: Reject any handoff whose emitted semantic text, including material_claims[*].uncertainty.summary, contains a retained source excerpt, and add a regression proving an exact retained excerpt placed only in uncertainty.summary is rejected.
finding.issue: The architecture handoff copies material_claims[*].uncertainty into the handoff but the retained_excerpt exclusion check inspects only claim statement text, project_assessment.summary, closure.summary, and Brief text. A retained source excerpt can therefore pass through uncertainty.summary, violating AC7's no-source-excerpts boundary.
